data.title: 诀 · 月影素床卸甲相拥
data.action: 半卧月光素白床榻轻抬下颌呼吸微促
data.lighting: 清冷银白月光透过纱帘勾勒肌肤与发丝
data.description: 月色顺着薄纱窗帘铺在素白床单上，将她灰白渐青的长发与头侧羽翼映出柔和银边。彻底卸下防备与衣物的李织烟半倚枕间，冷白肌肤在夜色里微微泛红，胸口随着略微急促的呼吸轻伏。向来习惯独自硬撑的应龙队长伸出手，轻声让你留在这个只属于两人的夜晚。
data.promptProse: Resting back against pale silk pillows bathed in cool silver moonlight, Arcane lies unadorned with a white sheet loosely draped across her lower hips, flushed cheeks and parted lips betraying rare vulnerability as she looks at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: She rests naked among moonlit white sheets with a soft flush across her skin, gazing warmly up at the viewer with parted lips.
data.nsfwProse: Her bare upper body and collarbones catch the soft silver moonlight above the loosely draped white sheet.
